notes: Subject length, part of the same answer: the commit-msg hook (M2) refuses a subject over 72 characters, the `[commits] max_subject` in `.agents/config/standards.toml`, and the floor caps it at 72 (`commit_max_subject`). Earlier subjects in this repository run to 91 characters; the hook judges only new commits, so none is rewritten. Keep 72, or raise both numbers together in one pull request you review.
Recommendation (from the M2 build, not yet put to the board): keep 72, the common git convention. Waits: `just hooks-install` on this checkout.
question: Conventional Commits, or "what and why, one line"?
recommendation: keep "what and why, one line"; add a type prefix only if release automation needs it.
